### CVE-2008-2138
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2008-05-12 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 31770: Oracle Application Server Portal 10g - Authentication Bypass (remote/multiple, 2008-05-09, verified=1)

Oracle Application Server (OracleAS) Portal 10g allows remote attackers to bypass intended access restrictions and read the contents of /dav_portal/portal/ by sending a request containing a trailing "%0A" (encoded line feed), then using the session ID that is generated from that request.  NOTE: as of 20080512, Oracle has not commented on the accuracy of this report.

### CVE-2008-3257
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2008-07-22 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 6089: Bea Weblogic Apache Connector - Code Execution / Denial of Service (remote/windows, 2008-07-17, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 18897: Oracle Weblogic Apache Connector - POST Buffer Overflow (Metasploit) (remote/windows, 2012-05-19, verified=1)

### CVE-2008-6065
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2009-02-05 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 32475: Oracle Database Server 11.1 - 'CREATE ANY Directory' Privilege Escalation (remote/multiple, 2008-10-13, verified=1)

Oracle Database Server 10.1, 10.2, and 11g grants directory WRITE permissions for arbitrary pathnames that are aliased in a CREATE OR REPLACE DIRECTORY statement, which allows remote authenticated users with CREATE ANY DIRECTORY privileges to gain SYSDBA privileges by aliasing the pathname of the password directory, and then overwriting the password file through UTL_FILE operations, a related issue to CVE-2006-7141.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a
